changelog: Intersects any number of genre groups (groups repeated, | ORs within a group), removing the stock two-group ceiling, with a browse-view filter UI and a settings page. Supports Jellyfin 12.1.0.
description: Filter a Jellyfin library by several genres at once — movies that are both Action and Comedy, not Action or Comedy.
name: Intersect — Multi-Criteria Filtering
overview: Adds an Intersect filter to the browse view: pick any number of genres and see only the items that carry all of them. The stock API can AND at most two genre groups; this plugin removes that ceiling.
